text: A set of formulas Γ is satisfiable iff:
choices: every formula in Γ is a tautology
there is a truth assignment making all formulas in Γ true simultaneously
Γ is consistent with the axioms
explanation: Satisfiable: ∃ valuation v such that v(φ)=T for all φ∈Γ. This is the semantic notion (a model exists).
